source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In D228378 the storage reviewer warns that callers set LoadGroup, owner and flags before AsyncOpen, while a pump may not yet be initialized. After acceptance with follow-up concerns, the author restores local getters/setters; guarded Cancel/Suspend proxying stays separate. The actual landing stores LoadGroup locally. Later review clarification notes that cited examples also keep their own LoadGroup. This is the scoped channel initialization contract, not a universal ban on proxy objects or proof that current pump internals fail. No channel or pump test ran.
title: Keep pre-open channel attributes outside an uninitialized pump
